newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Two S.Korean firms pass on 21,500T wheat tender.
newsitem.headline: Two S.Korean firms pass on 21,500T wheat tender.

text.p: South Korea's Cheiljedang Corp and Dongah Flour Mills Co Ltd have passed on tenders to jointly buy 21,500 tonnes of U.S. No.1 wheat due to higher-than-expected prices, company officials said on Thursday.
Of the total, Cheiljedang had sought 11,000 tonnes at basis prices over December futures on the U.S. grain futures exchanges including the Chicago Board of Trade, they said.
Dongah Flour had sought the remaining 10,500 tonnes at fixed prices.
Shipment was set for September 5-October 5 to the western port of Inchon.
Meanwhile, traders said the lowest offer was made by Japanese trading house Marubeni Corp.
